page_title: TOT 3-1 NOT | Tottenham Hotspur v Nottingham Forest 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
90+6' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+6' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) passes the ball onto Heung-Min Son, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. The ball goes out for a corner. Tottenham can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
90+2' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and it's Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Here comes a substitution. Dane Scarlett (Tottenham) is brought on as a substitute for Brennan Johnson.
88' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
88' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simon Hooper saw the whole situation. Nottingham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch so that Neco Williams can be given a rest.
86' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

85' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a daisy-cutter shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper produces an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and hits the post. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Ryan Yates and he is replaced by Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham).
81' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) replacing Danilo.
79' A quickly taken corner by Tottenham.
78' Danilo (Nottingham) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
76' Here's the change. James Maddison leaves the pitch and Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.
76' Timo Werner goes off the pitch and Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) comes on.
71' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
68' Here is a change. Morgan Gibbs-White is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
68' A substitution has been made. Chris Wood goes off and Divock Origi (Nottingham) comes on.
65' A pass by Timo Werner (Tottenham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
64' Tottenham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
62' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
62' James Maddison (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' 3 - 1 Gooal! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Rodrigo Bentancur. He makes it 3:1.
56' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.

55' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
52' 2 - 1 Goal! Heung-Min Son slips it to Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) on the edge of the box and he finds the top left corner with a great effort. The score is 2:1.
52' Tottenham take a short corner kick.
52' Chris Wood (Nottingham) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario is prepared to thwart his effort.

49' Timo Werner beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
49' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Chris Wood (Nottingham) offside.
48' Tottenham take a short corner kick.

47' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) latched on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately slams the ball towards the top right corner. His effort was thwarted by the alert goalkeeper, who pulled off a stunning save. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
47' A quickly taken corner by Tottenham.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Yves Bissouma is replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
46' Half-time substitution. Ange Postecoglou decided to make a change. Pape Matar Sarr is replaced by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
45+3' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Tottenham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
44' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Tottenham will take a corner kick.
42' Tottenham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

38' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
35' Oh, what a chance! Chris Wood (Nottingham) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the right post.

35' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Guglielmo Vicario makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.

33' Timo Werner (Tottenham) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
32' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' 1 - 1 It's 1:1! Anthony Elanga feeds Chris Wood (Nottingham) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
27' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matz Sels, who smothers the ball.
25' Timo Werner (Tottenham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
24' A pass from Timo Werner (Tottenham) is intercepted by Matz Sels and the move breaks down.
23' PENALTY APPEAL by Tottenham, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
22' Great teamplay by Nottingham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
19' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Guglielmo Vicario makes a smart save to deny him.

18' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
15' 1 - 0 Own goal! Murillo (Nottingham) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 1:0.
14' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
13' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.

11' What an opportunity! Murillo (Nottingham) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
8' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
7' Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul after Ryan Yates (Nottingham) hacks down one of his opponents.
6' Timo Werner (Tottenham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
6' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

3' A short pass finds Yves Bissouma (Tottenham). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
2' Tottenham take a short corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
